_doc: M1 §8 — skill→manager hook-in registry. Config-driven agent routing for SKILLS, the sibling of the sprint hook-point registry (_org/sprint-hook-points.json). Each row binds a skill's dispatch HOOK POINT to an agent ROLE that is resolved AT CALL TIME from the role-registry keystone (_org/role-registry.json) — never a hardcoded name in skill prose. A role rename/swap = ONE edit here (the `role` id) + the registry, not N edits across skill bodies. Resolver: scripts/skills/skill-hook-points.js (pure, CLI: `node scripts/skills/skill-hook-points.js <skill> [hook_point]`). Enforcer: scan:skill-hook-coverage (bidirectional, mirrors scan:sprint-hook-coverage) — every agent-calling skill has an entry · every entry resolves to a real role · no skill hardcodes a role name. Conditional rows (a skill that routes to different roles by scope) carry a `condition`; exactly one row per (skill,hook_point) may set `default:true` as the no-regression fallback when the condition is ambiguous.
